DETERMINATION A-O METHODS A high performance liquid chromatographic method for the determination of clomazone content in technical and formulation samples have been prescribed. A-1 HIGH PERFORMANCE LIQUID CHROMATOGRAPHIC METHOD A-1.l Principle OF CLOMAZONE CONTENT

A-1.3 Reagents A-1.3.1 Internal Standard, Acetophenone grade. A-1.3.2 Methanol -- HPLC grade. A-1.3.3 A-1.3.4

-- AR

Water -- HPLC grade. Tetrahydrofuran -- HPLC grade

A-1.4 Procedure A-1.4.1

Content of clomazone in the sample is determined in comparison to an internal standard, acetophenone. The test solution contains a known concentration of acetophenone. The clomazone content is obtained by comparing the relative peak area of the clomazone to the peak area of the acetophenone, taking into account the amount of clomazone sample being analyzed. A-1.2 A-1.2.1 Apparatus

Preparation of Internal Standard Solution

Weigh accurately 0;1 -g of acetophenone into a 100 ml volumetric flask and make up the volume with methanol. A-1.4.2

Preparation of Standard Solution

High Pe~ormance Liquid Chromatography

Weigh accurately 0.1 g of clomazone standard into a 50 ml volumetric flask, add 5 ml of internal standard solution and make up to volume with methanol. A-1.4.3. Preparation of Sample Solution Weigh accurately a quantity of sample equivalent to 0.100 g of clomazone into a 50 ml volumetric flask, add 5 ml of internal standard solution and then make up to the volume with methanol. A-1.4.4

A high performance liquid chromatography with ultra-violet (UV) detector and PC based data system is used for this determination. The suggested operative parameters are as follows, but can be changed if necessary, provided standardization is done: Column Mobile phase : : : : : : : Flexit C18-Spherisorb, 4.6 mm id. x 250 mm long, S.S.

Estimation

Successively inject 5 @ each of standard and sample solutions and measure the areas of clomazone and Methanol+ Water+ Tetrahydrofiuan (48+40+12, v/v) internal standard peaks in respective chromatograms. 1.0 ml/min 254 nm 0.04 AUFS 5@ Clomazone (a.i.) : 7.2 min (approximately) : 4.6 min (approximately) (Internal standard) A-1.5 Calculations
